name: ReviselyOnnxRuntime
summary: ONNX Runtime 1.31.1's iOS xcframework, from Microsoft's signed NuGet package, pinned by SHA-256
description: ONNX Runtime's own pod (onnxruntime-c) downloads from download.onnxruntime.ai, which serves a certificate for another name (Nov 23 2026), and its CocoaPods releases stop at 1.30.0. The same xcframework ships inside Microsoft.ML.OnnxRuntime on nuget.org, signed by Microsoft: that package, at one version, checked by its SHA-256. 1.31.1 is the version Revisely's checker runs.
